## Creating a New Tool

```bash
# Using the Makefile (recommended)
make new-tool NAME=my-tool-name

# Or manually
cp -r tools/_template tools/my-tool-name
cp specs/_templates/tool-spec.md specs/catalog/my-tool-name.md
```

See [Creating a New Tool Guide](../docs/guides/creating-a-new-tool.md) for details.

---

## Tool Template

The canonical template is in [`_template/`](_template/). Every tool must follow
this structure. See the [Tool Development Guide](../docs/book/03-tool-development-guide.md).
